fields.AN_Notes: Other_Task: hiring decisions (resume scoring) and facial recognition, both outside social work. Gender enters the regression as a binary dummy (Male=1, Female=0); nonbinary individuals are named only as stakeholders for participatory design, so the analysis stays Binary_Categorical. Intersectional rests on Table 2, where Black women show error rates that differ from both White women and Black men. Mitigation (inclusive datasets, bias audits, participatory design, diverse teams) is recommended only; the announced assessment of transparency and fairness interventions reports perceptions, not an evaluated intervention. fields.AN_Notes: Invited paper on ChatGPT in social work research. fields.AN_Notes: Higher-education framework of the Open University for staff and students. General_Guidance strategies, verbatim: 'Use the same/different prompt(s) several times with the same/different tool(s) and compare the outputs to identify and mitigate potential (cultural) bias.' and 'Engage in a conversation with AI to challenge detected biases.' and 'prompting for inclusivity'. The comparison of outputs is used for bias detection, not combined into one answer, so Ensembling is not coded. Bias axes appear only in an enumeration (gender, cultural, disability, racial), so no axis is coded. Epistemic injustice and the non-inclusive nature of outputs are asserted as premises without a mechanism the framework itself develops, so no harm type is coded. Mitigation: inclusive prompting and embedding Critical AI Literacy in curricula and staff development, proposed.
